Call-vs-not is decided ONLY by vbnet.Ref.IsCall(), which composes the per-file declaration table's ParenKind verdict with the New prefix and the statement-head rule — VB reuses parentheses for array indexing and default properties, so a 'looks like a call' regex is exactly the phantom-CALLS failure this epic exists to prevent; intrinsics (CType, CInt, GetType) are call-SHAPED but resolve to no declaration and are excluded, which matters because one WinForms designer file in the corpus contains hundreds of CType. callTarget independently refuses a Ref that is Qualified with an empty Qualifier (a With-block target or an expression result — real but unnameable per-file; 1,624 of 41,748 use sites measured) so the invariant does not rest on IsCall composition holding, strips Me/MyClass/MyBase (which denote the current instance and would guarantee a dangling edge), and calls are de-duplicated per owning declaration. MEASURED on the 302-file corpus: CALLS 5,059 total, 3,386 resolved (67%); the residue is BCL/WinForms members with no in-tree declaration. Honest caveat on the sibling edges: EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS carry the TYPE's declaration line rather than the Inherits/Implements clause line, because vbnet.Node records those clauses as a []string with no positions. |
